pool_method: Fixed pool of the 25 fine-v1 source images assigned to C, visually inspected and compared with each revised C query. This is a limited source-image pool, not exhaustive test-gallery annotation or the union of model Top-K results.

checks.text: A kiteboarder is airborne above the water.
checks.notes: Board and rider are visibly above the water; revised parasurfer to kiteboarder. No other C pool image shows this activity.

checks.text: Four people pose together with ski poles on snow, with a brown dog lying in front of them.
checks.notes: Count refers to the foreground group of four, not every background person. Removed unsupported shoulder-holding claim; two dogs are visible but only foreground lying dog is specified.

checks.text: A person balances on one hand in front of a yellow building.
checks.notes: One-hand balance and yellow building visible; removed unnecessary skin-tone description and corrected grammar.

checks.text: A man in a red floral shirt faces two other people.
checks.notes: Three people visible; middle person wears a red floral shirt. A still frame cannot establish a conversation or shirt origin.

checks.text: A group of people dance in front of a raised stage.
checks.notes: Raised arms and crowd in front of illuminated stage visible. Removed uncertain exact DJ count and performer role.

checks.text: A dog stands on a beach with a large rock behind it.
checks.notes: Standing dog and offshore rock visible. Static standing is included as a posture action under the shared annotation convention.

checks.text: Four children sit on tall stools at a counter.
checks.notes: Four seated children and high stools visible; removed unnecessary venue assumption.

checks.text: Two people holding fishing rods stand on a shore.
checks.notes: Two foreground people and their fishing equipment visible.

checks.text: Three children look through the bars of a cage.
checks.notes: Three faces visible behind bars; removed subjective well-dressed descriptor.

checks.text: Three children play in the sand on a beach.
checks.notes: Three children visible in sandy foreground; another beach C image shows one shirtless boy, not three children.

checks.text: Three people pose together and smile at the camera.
checks.notes: Three posing people visible; count retained without requiring gender inference.

checks.text: An adult poses with two children, one kissing the adult's cheek and the other making a face.
checks.notes: Two children visible; right child kisses adult's cheek and left child opens mouth toward camera.

checks.text: An athlete in a red and white uniform holds a shot beside her neck.
checks.notes: Shot near neck and uniform colors visible; frame shows preparation rather than the release of a throw.

checks.text: A girl wearing a pink shirt sits at a table beside a tall milkshake.
checks.notes: Pink shirt and large drink visible; drink flavor is not established visually.

checks.text: A man in a red top stands on rocks beside a yellow kayak.
checks.notes: Red top, yellow kayak and rocky shoreline visible; exact water-body type omitted.

checks.text: A man in a green striped shirt looks down at a cellphone.
checks.notes: Green stripes, garment over shoulders and small device in hands visible.

checks.text: A dark brown dog leans from a grassy bank toward the water.
checks.notes: Dark dog with head lowered to water at grassy edge; no drinking action asserted.

checks.text: A girl holds a yellow board beside the water.
checks.notes: Girl leaning against yellow board visible; omitted sand/standing details not established by this crop.

checks.text: Two dogs rear up facing each other indoors.
checks.notes: Two dogs visible indoors; play versus aggression cannot be established. Outdoor pair in fine_087 does not match indoors.

checks.text: A shirtless boy in blue patterned shorts stands beside the water.
checks.notes: Visible clothing and posture replace broad playing claim; distinguishes the other beach children in the limited pool.

checks.text: A woman in a black dress and red shoes walks along a street.
checks.notes: Black dress, red shoes and red hair accessory visible; walking posture supported.

checks.text: A black-and-tan dog and a light-colored dog move along asphalt beside grass.
checks.notes: Two dogs outdoors by grass; corrected solid-black color claim. Speed cannot be inferred precisely.

checks.text: People sit and stand among rows of white tents under trees.
checks.notes: Tents, trees and people visible; removed unobservable refugee status.

checks.text: A person in a dark uniform faces a jumping dog on a grassy field.
checks.notes: Dog airborne in front of uniformed person. Removed imprecise all-black dog color and ambiguous playing claim.

checks.text: A snowboarder balances on a metal rail above the snow.
checks.notes: Board on rail visible; corrected snowboarder spelling.
Running person and dusty path visible. Through grass is route context rather than a clear object-to-object spatial relation; consider replacing relation category with action.
Two seated people, two bicycles and river visible. Beside relation is supported; source image should remain relevant.
Dog visibly airborne through held hoops. Action and spatial relation supported.
Waterfront path and foreground walker visible; relationship as a couple cannot be established. Use people walking along a waterfront path.
Red vest and running posture visible; heavy water spray/rain visible but through rain is weak as an object relation. Keep color/action, omit uncertain weather source if needed.
Yellow-clad person, instruments and crowd visible; setting up a band is an inferred event. Prefer a person in yellow bending beside musical instruments and a crowd.
Four skiers visible across the slope, including two toward upper right. Uphill activity plausible; retain count after checking full resolution.
Two seated people in green ponchos and rows of empty seats visible; remove subjective lonely and unverified fan role.
Two foreground walkers on lit street at night visible; avoid requiring an inferred gender label if ambiguous.
Two running people at shoreline and extended pointing arm visible. Count/action supported.
Two dogs at fence visible; upper dog straddles fence. Breed and fighting interpretation are uncertain; prefer two dogs interacting across a fence.
Two dogs wearing shirts in grass visible. Count/color/action supported; retain without assigning aggression.
Foreground person in red puffer jacket visible. Surrounded by people is overstated because others are distant in background; prefer a person in a red jacket outdoors.
Dark wet dog airborne over water near a bank visible. Exact water-body type uncertain; use water instead of lake if needed.
Blue-shirted person with camera visible; backpack wearer faces away and appears farther right. Boy age/gender claim not necessary; use another person carrying a backpack.
Red shirt and skateboard trick visible; supported color/action query.
Person and dog on wet or frozen shoreline visible. Direction toward each other is uncertain from frame; avoid inferring both trajectories.
Black dog carries long brown material in mouth while in surf. Seaweed versus stick uncertain; use a long object unless full-resolution view establishes material.
Child hanging or climbing on green playground bars visible. Refine generic playing to climbing or hanging if supported by full image.
Large golden dog and smaller dark dog visible interacting; size relation and count supported.
White-dressed child reaching toward bubbles, adult and second child at side visible. Mother/daughter relationship not observable; replace with an adult and another child.
Dog in shallow blue plastic pool with water droplets visible. A more specific description can improve fine-grained usefulness.
People and bus on urban street visible; vehicle door/open state is unclear in thumbnail. Check full image or omit open qualifier.
Two foreground silhouettes on beach at sunset plus distant group visible. Exact walking direction should be checked rather than inferred from spacing.
Three people with head scarves stand together; count and posture visible. No religious identity inferred from clothing.
